report.summary: CONTENT, fixed and proved through the real client. Cold War's agility instructor wrote stage 100 -> 105 with no course check, and the fence gate carried a player from the course START into the finish pen (it always telejumped one square south of the gate, which sits on the WEST edge of 2652,4039: pre-fix course probe C8.gate from 2651,4040 landed 2652,4038 beside the instructor; parity legE E1.stage105 reached 105 with goto+gate and no obstacle). Fix: (1) coldwar_outpost.rs2 ~coldwar_course_leg counts the cache's %varb3305_peng_agility_state 1/2/3 in order at stage 100 (stone 7, last icicle pillar x=2662, ice) and the instructor refuses 100->105 below 3, resetting it to 0 after (capture still restarts it as the Icelord count at 125). The shared lap tracker could not carry this: its step 1 is the Crusher, an npc with no op in all.npc, so a penguin lap never starts. (2) penguin_course.rs2: the gate crosses its wall (finish/east -> start/west 2651,4039 is the obstacle with XP+lap; start -> finish is a plain crossing with no XP); the ice now ends with the wiki's slide to the finish line (telejump 2657,4039, past the inviswall 38848 that closed the slide lane 4 tiles short of the instructor); stone 7 is an [aploc1] worked from 2 tiles (stone 6's serverside wall + peng_coast_6 left no op-adjacent walked tile; seam-facts (k) pattern). Sources: wiki Cold War/Quick guide (course legs, slide cutscene, then Talk to Agility Instructor), Transcript:Cold_War (instructor: 'successfully completed the physical', 'go through the gate in the fence and use the same door you came out of'), wiki Penguin Agility Course ('slides down the snow jumps until they reach the finish line near the gate', Gate 65 XP), Quest Helper ColdWar.java steps.put(100) zone ladder; docs/quests/cold_war.md Package 3 names %peng_agility_state for the course. The refusal line's WORDING is port text (no transcript line exists); the refusal behaviour is the guide's order.

open_issues: No committed test/quests/coldwar.lua exists (QUEUE row 'todo', unauthored), so there is no file to copy with t.blocked removed; the course was proved by the scratch course.lua instead.

The course's water leg is still not drivable, and per the driver_other_floor_loc fixer it is NOT a driver seam: steps01/stepstone01/crushers are plane-0 (the client cannot press them from plane 1), engine terrain_is_ocean() treats overlay 537 (the wading water) as ocean so the player cannot walk in it, and no content takes the player from 2636,4054,1 down into the water. My proof crossed that leg with goto_tile onto the first stone (2630,4057,1); coldwar stays blocked at the water leg (ENGINE + CONTENT) until those land. Stone 7 (that fixer's item 3) is fixed here.

The Crusher npcs (peng_agility_crushcourse_crushblock01..04_npc) have no op in all.npc, so [opnpc1,crushblock] never fires: the penguin lap tracker never starts (lap course=17 step=0 throughout), so the gate's mark-of-grace/pet roll and the helper lap count are dead; the wiki's 55 Crusher XP is never paid. Pre-existing, not needed for Cold War; a content follow-up would move step 1/XP to exiting the water (stepstone01) -- unsourced detail, not done.
The refusal line 'You haven't finished the course yet, soldier. Back to the start and get round it!' is port wording: no source gives the instructor's line for an unfinished course.
The slide is a telejump with a mes, not the wiki's camera cutscene (no cam_* calls added, so gate.py's cutscene_row_required does not apply).
coldwar_debug.rs2 / poh files in the tree are modified by the concurrent clockwork seam, not by me.
